mages_legacy.message.level_up: Your legacy grows: race level %s, free points: %s

mages_legacy.mycelid.node_alone: The mycelium has nowhere to lead: no other node nearby
mages_legacy.command.no_race: You have not chosen a race yet
mages_legacy.lore.intro.1: Once all people were one folk: weak, mortal and all alike.
mages_legacy.lore.intro.2: Then came a mage whose name was forgotten before the first cities were built. He raised the first obelisk, and through its eye he saw what each of us could become.
mages_legacy.lore.intro.3: Some he gave to the earth, and mycelium grew through their bones. To others he gave a voice that beasts and the echoes of the fallen answer. A third folk he stopped in time. A fourth he made pay for life in blood. The fifth he led through the void and did not bring back whole.
mages_legacy.lore.intro.4: So one folk became five. The mage left, and no one saw where. But his gift did not vanish: it sleeps in the blood of everyone born into this world.
mages_legacy.lore.intro.5: Today it wakes in you. Choose whose legacy you will carry. The choice is made once.
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.lore.1: The mage gave them to the earth. Mycelium grew through their bones and became a second blood.
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.lore.2: Mycelids see in the dark, heal on mycelium and feed on mushrooms that poison everyone else.
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.lore.3: They say that somewhere under the roots of the world the mycelium still remembers the mage's voice and retells it to the Mycelids in their dreams.
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.perk.1: Spores: the race resource, growing by itself and faster in the dark, on mycelium and from mushrooms
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.perk.2: Night vision in the dark, regeneration in the dark and on mycelium
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.perk.3: Raw mushrooms are food (right click into the air) and give a taste: strength, resistance, fire resistance or speed
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.weak.1: Weakness and faster hunger in direct sunlight
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.weak.2: Fire burns half again as badly
mages_legacy.race.mycelid.weak.3: Meat feeds only half as well
mages_legacy.ability.mycelid.1.name: Spore Jump
mages_legacy.ability.mycelid.1.desc: A moment later you sprout where you look, up to 8 blocks away. 15 spores.
mages_legacy.ability.mycelid.1.lore: The spore flies ahead, the mycelium sprouts after it, and you with it.
mages_legacy.ability.mycelid.2.name: Spore Cloud
mages_legacy.ability.mycelid.2.desc: A cloud of radius 4 for 6 seconds: monsters go blind and are poisoned (the undead rot), players heal. 30 spores.
mages_legacy.ability.mycelid.2.lore: To enemies it is choking; to friends, the warm breath of an old forest.
mages_legacy.ability.mycelid.3.name: Mycelium
mages_legacy.ability.mycelid.3.desc: Grows a node of your network (up to 3). Right click a node to travel to the next one within 150 blocks. Anyone may use it. Opens after the Nether. 40 spores.
mages_legacy.ability.mycelid.3.lore: The mycelium remembers every node you grew and will lead anyone you trust along them.
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.tagline: Bonded beasts and echoes of the fallen
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.lore.1: The mage gave them a voice that beasts and the echoes of the departed answer.
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.lore.2: A Shepherd is frail, but never alone: a pack is always near, and an army of shadows stands behind.
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.perk.1: Echoes: summon undead and monsters you learned to call by slaying them
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.perk.2: Bonds: a special taming of beasts, from dogs and cats to mice, owls and hedgehogs
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.perk.3: Every bonded beast helps: finds ore, keeps watch, heals, scouts
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.weak.1: Less health and a weaker own strike
mages_legacy.race.shepherd.weak.3: A fallen beast does not return at once
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.1.name: Call
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.1.desc: Calls the whole active echo squad where you look, topping up whoever is missing. They stay until dawn. Sneak + Call dismisses all.
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.1.lore: Whoever fell by your hand rises at your word.
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.2.name: Rally
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.2.desc: Every creature of yours within 24 blocks gets Strength and Speed for 10 seconds and restores 30% of its health. You and other players nearby heal 2 hearts. 25 voice, once in 30 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.2.lore: One blast of the horn and the whole pack charges.
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.3.name: Whistle
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.3.desc: An order to the pack, in turn: "Follow" (they keep close and only fight back), "Guard" (they ring you, meet the monsters coming for you and take 20% less damage) and "Hunt" (they go after every monster within 24 blocks). Costs no voice. The Gather has its own key now (Alt).
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.3.lore: One whistle and the pack knows what to do. Herders taught it to their dogs long before the split.
mages_legacy.race.frozen.lore.1: Disciples of the nameless mage who stood beside him as he split people into races.
mages_legacy.race.frozen.lore.2: A shard of that moment struck them, and time has run through them unevenly ever since: they remember their last seconds and can go back into them.
mages_legacy.race.frozen.perk.1: Sand of time: the race resource, gathers by itself and from blows you take
mages_legacy.race.frozen.perk.2: Rewind: fly back as light along your own path, 4 seconds into the past
mages_legacy.race.frozen.perk.3: Blur: one blow in ten passes through you
mages_legacy.race.frozen.weak.1: Natural healing is twice as slow
mages_legacy.race.frozen.weak.2: Potions and good effects last 30% shorter
mages_legacy.race.frozen.weak.3: Ten minutes without spending sand bring numbness (Slowness)
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.1.name: Rewind
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.1.desc: You scatter into light and in half a second fly back along your own path to where you were 4 seconds ago. Nothing can touch you in flight, and a frozen silhouette stays where you started. Monsters lose sight of you, fire goes out. 30 sand, once in 12 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.1.lore: A moment that has not passed can be lived again.
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.2.name: Frozen Dome
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.2.desc: A dome of radius 5 for 6 seconds: enemies inside all but stop, and arrows and projectiles hang in the air. 45 sand, once in 25 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.2.lore: Under the dome time breathes slowly, like a sleeper.
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.3.name: Quickening
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.3.desc: The block you look at (up to 8 blocks away) works ten times faster for 30 seconds: furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces, brewing stands, lit campfires, and saplings and crops grow before your eyes. 20 sand.
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.3.lore: Sand runs faster if you give it a push.
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.lore.1: They offered the mage their blood in exchange for a long life. He took it and never gave it back.
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.lore.2: Ever since, the Bloodkin live on the blood of others: their own drains away, and only the hunt fills their veins again. Through walls they hear living hearts beat.
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.perk.1: Blood: the race resource, drains away by itself, filled only by hunting
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.perk.2: Vampirism: 10% of the damage to the living heals
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.perk.3: Blood sense: the living within 12 blocks show through walls
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.weak.1: Burn in the sun when the head is bare
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.weak.2: Ordinary food feeds them a third
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.1.name: Blood Dash
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.1.desc: A rush of 10 blocks where you look, through enemies: each takes 6 damage and bleeds. 20 blood, once in 6 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.1.lore: Blood knows its own way to another's heart.
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.2.name: Harvest
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.2.desc: Draws blood out of every enemy within 9 blocks: each takes 4 damage, and you get 2 health and 5 blood from each. 40 blood, once in 20 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.2.lore: Everyone standing near pays the mage's debt.
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.3.name: Blood Sacrifice
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.3.desc: Give 4 health and get 40 blood at once. It can never kill you. Once in 20 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.3.lore: Sometimes, to take, you must first give.
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.tagline: The void and a pocket of their own
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.lore.1: The mage led them through the first obelisk. They did not all come back: part of each of them is still there, in the void.
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.lore.2: To them the world is thin: walls, distances, even other bodies. And each has a pocket of the world of their own, to step into and to sleep in.
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.perk.1: The void: the race resource, gathers by itself, faster in the dark, three times as fast in the End and the Pocket
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.perk.2: The Pocket: a dimension of their own, a floating island under the stars, to step into and back out to the same spot
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.perk.4: One arrow or fireball in four passes through them
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.weak.1: Water burns them, as it burns endermen
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.1.name: Void Step
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.1.desc: Half a second's passage through the void: 14 blocks where you look, through walls, floors and ceilings. You come out where the body fits, never in stone or lava; bedrock won't let you through. Whatever is in the way takes 4 and is slowed. 20 void, once in 5 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.1.lore: A wall is only the thought of a wall.
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.2.name: Well
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.2.desc: A black hole where you look (up to 20 blocks) for 4 seconds: enemies within 8 blocks, their arrows and loose items are dragged into it, and its heart burns. At the end it collapses: 6 damage to all near it. 40 void, once in 25 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.2.lore: The void is hungry. Give it a point and it gathers everything to it.
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.3.name: Excision
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.3.desc: The creature you look at (up to 24 blocks) falls into your Pocket for 6 seconds and then comes back where it was. An enemy comes back dazed, a friend mended. Bosses are too big. 35 void, once in 15 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.3.lore: Anything can be taken out of the world for a while. Even what is about to explode.
mages_legacy.branch.mycelid.0.lore: Spores that choke enemies and heal friends.
mages_legacy.branch.mycelid.1.lore: Mycelium beneath the whole world: jumps, roots and nodes.
mages_legacy.branch.mycelid.2.lore: A body that feeds on mushrooms and darkness.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_wide.lore: Spores know no borders, only the wind.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_wide.desc: Spore Cloud radius 6 blocks instead of 4.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_trail.lore: Where you jumped from, a gift remains.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_trail.desc: Spore Jump leaves a small spore cloud at the start for 3 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_potent.lore: The older the mycelium, the bitterer its breath.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_potent.desc: The cloud poisons harder (Poison II) and slows monsters.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_infection.desc: A monster dying in your cloud gives 10 spores and twice the race experience.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_lingering.lore: Spores settle and are in no hurry to leave.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_lingering.desc: The cloud lasts 12 seconds instead of 6.
mages_legacy.talent.net_chain.lore: The mycelium sprouts faster than an enemy can turn.
mages_legacy.talent.net_chain.desc: After a jump, 2 more jumps within 3 seconds cost 5 spores each and have no cooldown.
mages_legacy.talent.net_reach.lore: A spore flies further if let go at the right moment.
mages_legacy.talent.net_reach.desc: Spore Jump reaches 12 blocks instead of 8.
mages_legacy.talent.net_nodes.lore: The more nodes, the more the world feels like home.
mages_legacy.talent.net_nodes.desc: Up to 5 mycelium nodes instead of 3.
mages_legacy.talent.net_far.desc: Nodes link across 500 blocks instead of 150.
mages_legacy.talent.net_roots.lore: Where you sprout, the earth holds strangers.
mages_legacy.talent.net_roots.desc: After a jump, monsters within 3 blocks can barely move for 2 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_two_tastes.lor: A Mycelid's stomach is wider than it looks.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_two_tastes.des: Two mushroom tastes work at once instead of one.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_rich.lore: A Mycelid knows which mushroom to pick and which to leave to ripen.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_rich.desc: Tastes are one level stronger (except resistance, which stays at I) and last 2 minutes instead of 1.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_dark_regen.lor: In the dark, wounds close like cracks in bark.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_dark_regen.des: Regeneration II instead of I in the dark and on mycelium.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_cap.lore: The skin hardens like the cap of an old mushroom.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_cap.desc: +4 armour while you are out of the sun.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_sunproof.lore: You carry the dark with you, and the sun has no power over you.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_sunproof.desc: The sun no longer causes weakness and hunger.
mages_legacy.guide.title: How the Legacy Grows
mages_legacy.guide.points.1: Every race level gives 1 point, every tenth level 2 more.
mages_legacy.guide.points.2: By level 50 you gather 60 points, but the whole tree costs 75: choose your path.
mages_legacy.guide.points.3: The price grows with the tier: 1, 2, 3 points, a crown 5.
mages_legacy.mycelid.reborn: The mycelium would not let you go: you sprouted at a node. Rebirth returns in 20 minutes.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_quick.lore: The mycelium never tires of breathing.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_quick.desc: The spore cloud recharges in 7 seconds instead of 10.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_weakness.lore: Spores gnaw at muscle from within.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_weakness.desc: Monsters in your cloud get Weakness II: their blows barely hurt.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_mending.lore: The mycelium gives its own what it took from strangers.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_mending.desc: Players in your cloud heal faster: Regeneration II instead of I.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_burst.lore: The cloud is born with a bang.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_burst.desc: As it forms, the spore cloud deals 4 damage to monsters around and throws them back.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_follow.lore: The swarm knows its master and follows.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_follow.desc: The spore cloud follows you instead of staying in place.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_bloom.lore: Death in the swarm only starts a new swarm.
mages_legacy.talent.swarm_bloom.desc: Crown. A monster dying in your cloud bursts into a new spore cloud for 3 seconds. A chain reaction.
mages_legacy.talent.net_light_step.lore: The mycelium catches those who fall.
mages_legacy.talent.net_cheap.lore: The lighter the spore, the farther the wind.
mages_legacy.talent.net_cheap.desc: The spore jump costs 10 spores instead of 15.
mages_legacy.talent.net_haste.lore: The network carries you farther than your step.
mages_legacy.talent.net_haste.desc: After travelling through a node: Speed II for 10 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.net_shared.lore: Every node is a second home.
mages_legacy.talent.net_shared.desc: Travelling through a node heals 4 health and gives 10 spores, at most once in 30 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.net_cleanse.lore: Sprouting anew, you leave sickness behind.
mages_legacy.talent.net_cleanse.desc: The spore jump removes all harmful effects from you on landing.
mages_legacy.talent.net_mind.lore: The mycelium sees all it touches.
mages_legacy.talent.net_mind.desc: Crown. Monsters within 24 blocks of your nodes glow: you see them through walls.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_fireproof.desc: Fire burns only 15% harder instead of half again as much.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_meat.desc: Meat feeds you as well as anyone.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_spore_blood.lo: Bite a Mycelid and choke on spores.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_spore_blood.de: A monster that hits you is poisoned for 3 seconds (the undead rot).
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_feast.desc: A raw mushroom gives 15 spores instead of 10 and heals 3 health.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_rebirth.lore: While the mycelium lives, so do you.
mages_legacy.talent.flesh_rebirth.desc: Crown. A killing blow instead carries you to your nearest node in this world with half health. Once in 20 minutes.
mages_legacy.xp.mycelid.1: Eat a raw mushroom or fungus
mages_legacy.xp.mycelid.3: A monster dies in your spore cloud
mages_legacy.xp.mycelid.4: Kill a monster in the dark
mages_legacy.ability.no_capacity: Every bond is taken: dismiss an echo or take off heavy armour
mages_legacy.ability.no_echo: Put an echo squad together in the bestiary (key U)
mages_legacy.ability.no_creature: Look at one of your creatures
mages_legacy.branch.shepherd.0.lore: Echoes of the fallen: more, sturdier, longer.
mages_legacy.branch.shepherd.1.lore: Living bonded beasts: skills, levels, loyalty.
mages_legacy.branch.shepherd.2.lore: The Shepherd itself: auras, commands, one heart.
mages_legacy.echo.name: Echo: %s
mages_legacy.echo.learned: The bestiary grows: the echo of "%s" now answers you
mages_legacy.bond.listening: %s listens to the Song of Bonds. Now: %s
mages_legacy.bond.too_soon: Let the beast settle: next feeding in %s s
mages_legacy.bond.need_fire: The last feeding of the ritual needs a burning campfire
mages_legacy.bond.done: Bond made: %s is with you now. Skill: %s
mages_legacy.bestiary.title: Shepherd's Bestiary
mages_legacy.bestiary.no_beasts: Nobody yet. How to bond: the "?" above
mages_legacy.bestiary.ritual.1: Song of Bonds (key %s): look at a wild beast and sing to it. For 20 minutes it listens, and in that time you walk its way
mages_legacy.bestiary.ritual.2: Your own beast: right click with an empty hand to pet, with its treat to feed (heals, +10% damage), sneak + right click to make it wait
mages_legacy.bestiary.pick: Left click adds it to the squad, right click takes one away
mages_legacy.message.shepherd_hint: Key U opens the bestiary: learn echoes by killing mobs, build squads from them (Y: next squad), and bond with beasts.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_cheap.lore: The dead hear even a whisper.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_cheap.desc: Calling an echo costs a quarter less voice.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_last_breath.l: Going, an echo takes the cold of the grave with it.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_last_breath.d: A falling echo bursts into frost: monsters within 4 blocks take 4 damage and Slowness II for 3 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_sturdy.lore: The echo clings harder to this world.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_capacity.lore: The Shepherd's voice holds more shadows.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_sleepless.lor: Dawn no longer drives them away.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_sleepless.des: Echoes no longer fade at dawn: they stay until dismissed (sneak + Call).
mages_legacy.talent.legion_return.lore: A fallen echo gives its voice back.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_return.desc: When an echo falls, half the voice of its Call comes back.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_weapons.lore: They remember how they held their blades.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_more.lore: The army grows with every fallen foe.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_leech.lore: Every death at an echo's hand feeds the voice.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_leech.desc: Every kill by your echoes restores 5 voice.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_army.lore: All you ever defeated rise at once.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_army.desc: Crown. Rally calls one echo of each of the six mightiest kinds you learned for 30 seconds, free of capacity. Once in 10 minutes.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_fed.lore: A fed beast knows no weariness.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_fed.desc: Feeding heals a beast fully. Being fed lasts 20 minutes instead of 10, gives +15% damage instead of +10% and heals a heart every 2 seconds instead of 5.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_thick.lore: Bonded beasts grow sturdy beside you.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_levels.desc: Beasts learn twice as fast and grow to level 20 instead of 10 (up to 4 skill power from levels).
mages_legacy.talent.pack_skill.lore: Every beast unfolds its gift in full.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_skill.desc: Every beast skill is 1 power stronger: wider reach, more often, stronger effects.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_not_today.lore: A Shepherd does not let its own go.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_not_today.desc: A beast dealt a killing blow stays in the fight with half its health and Resistance IV for 5 seconds instead of going to rest. Once in 5 minutes per beast.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_instant.desc: A fallen beast comes back in 30 seconds instead of 5 minutes.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_fury.lore: Touch the Shepherd and you wake the pack.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_fury.desc: Below half health, your beasts get Strength II and Speed.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_alpha.lore: One of the pack becomes more than a beast.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_alpha.desc: Crown. The pack leader (pick it with RMB in the bestiary, else the highest-level beast): skill 2 power stronger, +50% health, +4 damage, Resistance. Beasts near it get Strength and Resistance.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_deep.lore: The Shepherd's voice rises from the earth itself.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_capacity.lore: A Shepherd's heart has room for all.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_armor.lore: Iron no longer muffles the voice.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_armor.desc: Iron and chainmail armour no longer lower bond capacity (diamond and netherite still do).
mages_legacy.talent.voice_rally.lore: The Rally is heard beyond the hills.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_rally.desc: Rally gives Strength II and Resistance.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_strength.desc: Your own blows are only 10% weaker instead of a quarter.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_life.lore: The mage's gift no longer takes your strength.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_life.desc: You lose only one heart instead of two.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_aura.lore: Near you, your own feel better.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_heart.lore: The Shepherd's pain is shared by all who are loyal.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_heart.desc: Crown. Half the damage you take is shared among your creatures within 16 blocks.
mages_legacy.xp.shepherd.5: Sing the Song of Bonds to a new beast
mages_legacy.beast.wolf.skill_desc: Hits harder near you (Strength); its bite slows the foe
mages_legacy.beast.cat.skill_desc: Makes monsters around it glow; at night gives you night vision
mages_legacy.beast.fox.skill_desc: Brings you items lying around, and digs up a find every 5 minutes
mages_legacy.beast.bee.skill_desc: Heals you and your creatures, cures poison and wither
mages_legacy.beast.axolotl.skill_desc: In water: breathing, dolphin's grace and regeneration, cures poison
mages_legacy.bond.fox_awake: A fox is sung to only while she sleeps (by day)
mages_legacy.bond.another_flower: She wants a flower of another kind
mages_legacy.bond.headbutt_first: Butt heads with her bare-handed first
mages_legacy.bond.headbutts_done: The goat accepts you (%s of %s). Give her wheat
mages_legacy.beast.parrot.warn: The parrot cries out: %s is hunting you!
mages_legacy.echo.trait.zombie: Living shield: monsters nearby leave the Shepherd and go for it
mages_legacy.echo.trait.husk: Withering blow: Slowness II and hunger
mages_legacy.echo.trait.drowned: Near it, the Shepherd swims fast and breathes underwater
mages_legacy.echo.trait.skeleton: Its arrows mark the target and the whole army goes for it
mages_legacy.echo.trait.spider: One blow in four leaves a cobweb at the foe's feet
mages_legacy.echo.trait.vindicator: Executioner: double damage to foes under 30% health
mages_legacy.echo.trait.blaze: Near it, the Shepherd doesn't burn
mages_legacy.echo.trait.wither_skeleton: Wither II; every blow heals the Shepherd
mages_legacy.beast.wolf.taming: feed it meat ×%s, a minute apart; the last time by a burning campfire
mages_legacy.beast.cat.taming: crouch beside it with fish in hand for %s seconds
mages_legacy.beast.fox.taming: sing to her while she sleeps (by day), then give her glow berries
mages_legacy.beast.axolotl.taming: give it a bucket of tropical fish ×%s while you swim beside it, a minute apart
mages_legacy.beast.goat.skill_desc: Rams monsters at your side: damage and a hard knockback
mages_legacy.beast.goat.taming: butt heads with her bare-handed ×%s (no harm), then give her wheat
mages_legacy.beast.polar_bear.skill_desc: Monsters leave you and go for it; near it you take 20% less damage
mages_legacy.beast.polar_bear.taming: kill monsters in front of it ×%s
mages_legacy.beast.parrot.skill_desc: Cries out and marks monsters hunting you; catches you when you fall
mages_legacy.beast.parrot.taming: sing it the Song ×%s by a playing jukebox, a minute apart
mages_legacy.beast.frog.skill_desc: Pulls monsters in with its tongue and slows them; eats small slimes
mages_legacy.beast.frog.taming: feed it slimeballs ×%s, a minute apart
mages_legacy.bestiary.squad_empty: The squad is empty: click a learned echo below
mages_legacy.echo.squad_full: The whole squad is already with you
mages_legacy.bond.swim_with_it: A dolphin takes the fish only while you swim beside it
mages_legacy.echo.trait.silverfish: A swarm: three come for one squad place; their bites slow
mages_legacy.echo.trait.witch: Herbalist: every 10 seconds heals you and the creatures near her
mages_legacy.echo.trait.vex: Flies through walls and reaches foes anywhere
mages_legacy.echo.trait.ravager: Battering ram: every 6 seconds a roar throws back the monsters around it
mages_legacy.beast.llama.skill_desc: Spits at monsters near you and slows them; carries a chest
mages_legacy.beast.llama.taming: walk her on a lead for %s seconds
mages_legacy.beast.rabbit.skill_desc: Near it you get Luck and Jump Boost
mages_legacy.beast.rabbit.taming: give it a golden carrot ×%s, a minute apart
mages_legacy.beast.turtle.skill_desc: Below 30% health you get Resistance II and absorption (once in 90 s)
mages_legacy.beast.turtle.taming: feed it seagrass ×%s, a minute apart
mages_legacy.beast.dolphin.skill_desc: Underwater: conduit power and dolphin's grace
mages_legacy.beast.dolphin.taming: give it fish ×%s while you swim beside it, a minute apart
mages_legacy.beast.bat.taming: sing her the Song ×%s underground (no sky above), a minute apart
mages_legacy.talent.legion_resonance.lor: The echoes remember their strength in full.
mages_legacy.talent.legion_resonance.des: Every echo trait grows: the zombie draws monsters from 14 blocks, a cobweb every second blow, the executioner finishes foes at 45%, the witch heals and the ravager roars more often, and so on.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_fast.desc: Bonded beasts always have Speed, and any left more than 16 blocks behind jumps to your side.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_light.lore: The deeper the trust, the lighter the bond.
mages_legacy.talent.pack_light.desc: Every beast takes one bond slot less (never below one): wolf, goat, llama and dolphin take 1, the polar bear 2.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_mend.lore: Under a Shepherd's hand a beast forgets its pain.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_mend.desc: The Rally heals your creatures for 50% of their health instead of 30% and cleanses them of harmful effects.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_banner.lore: Beside its Shepherd the pack fights fiercer.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_banner.desc: Your creatures within 16 blocks of you deal 20% more damage.
mages_legacy.talent.voice_loss.desc: When one of your echoes falls in battle or a beast goes to rest, you get absorption and 10 voice.
mages_legacy.bond.underground: A bat listens only underground, with no sky above
mages_legacy.bond.need_music: A parrot listens to the Song only while a jukebox plays nearby
mages_legacy.bestiary.leader: Pack leader: skill 2 power stronger, +50% health, beasts near it get Strength and Resistance
mages_legacy.bestiary.leader_no_crown: Chosen as leader (works with the Alpha crown)
mages_legacy.bestiary.beast_hint: LMB: name it · RMB: make it the leader
mages_legacy.bestiary.name: Beast's name
key.mages_legacy.ability_4: Race ability 4 (the Shepherds' Song of Bonds, the Voidborn's Pocket)
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.4.name: Song of Bonds
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.4.desc: Where taming begins. Sing to the beast you look at (up to 8 blocks): for 20 minutes it listens, and in that time you walk its own way (every beast has one, see the bestiary). Parrots and bats are won by the songs themselves. 20 voice, once in 30 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.4.lore: The song the nameless mage once called the beasts with. The Shepherds still remember it.
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.5.name: Gather
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.5.desc: All your creatures within 64 blocks jump to your side, except those told to stay. 10 voice, once in 8 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.shepherd.5.lore: One short call, and the pack is at your feet.
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.4.name: Feast
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.4.desc: Crown of the Fang. For 8 seconds every blow heals you by all the damage it deals. 30 blood, once in 5 minutes.
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.4.lore: Once in a while blood flows like a river.
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.5.name: Swarm
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.5.desc: Scatter into a swarm of bats for 3 seconds, flying where you look, untouchable. 30 blood, once in 30 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.bloodkin.5.lore: You are not a body, you are a flock.
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.4.name: Current
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.4.desc: Crown of the Flow. For 30 seconds you do everything twice as fast (Speed II, Haste II, Strength), and your abilities recharge twice as fast. 30 sand, once in 5 minutes.
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.4.lore: Time flows through you, and you through time.
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.5.name: Stopping Gaze
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.5.desc: The enemy you look at (up to 16 blocks) freezes for 3 seconds. 25 sand, once in 20 seconds.
mages_legacy.ability.frozen.5.lore: One look and the moment does not move.
mages_legacy.ability.no_beast: Look at a beast that can be bonded (up to 8 blocks)
mages_legacy.bond.already_yours: %s is already yours. Right click with an empty hand to pet it, with its treat to feed it
mages_legacy.bond.stay: %s waits here. Sneak + right click to call it along again
mages_legacy.bond.petted: %s is happy: +5 voice, the beast mends and learns a little
mages_legacy.bond.fed: %s is fed for %s min: it heals and hits harder
mages_legacy.bond.full: %s is fed and healthy (%s min more)
mages_legacy.bestiary.fed: Fed for %s min more: heals and hits 10% harder
mages_legacy.bestiary.wants_pet: Wants to be petted (right click with an empty hand)
mages_legacy.whistle.2: Whistle: "Hunt!" The pack goes after the monsters around
mages_legacy.race.frozen.perk.4: They quicken furnaces, brewing and growing plants for everyone
mages_legacy.race.frozen.perk.5: Strike through time: blows on an enemy your Dome or Gaze holds land 30% harder
mages_legacy.branch.frozen.0.lore: The Rewind: farther, more often, for yourself and others.
mages_legacy.branch.frozen.1.lore: The Dome: wider, longer, more merciless.
mages_legacy.branch.frozen.2.lore: The Frozen's own time: pace, speed, blows.
mages_legacy.xp.frozen.2: Rewind right after taking a blow
mages_legacy.xp.frozen.4: A monster died under your Dome
mages_legacy.frozen.no_trail: No way back yet: wait a moment
mages_legacy.frozen.nothing_to_quicken: Nothing to quicken here: look at a furnace, a brewing stand, a campfire or a plant
mages_legacy.frozen.eternal: Eternal Moment: for 6 seconds you cannot be killed
mages_legacy.frozen.still_frame: Still Frame: everything around stands still
mages_legacy.talent.loop_heal.desc: The Rewind gives back half of the health you lost over those 4 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_cheap.lore: A moment weighs less than it seems.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_cheap.desc: The Rewind costs 20 sand instead of 30.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_quick.lore: The more often you return, the shorter the way.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_quick.desc: The Rewind recharges in 8 seconds instead of 12.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_long.lore: You remember longer than others do.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_long.desc: The Rewind takes you 6 seconds back instead of 4.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_cleanse.lore: Where you were, nobody had poisoned you yet.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_cleanse.desc: The Rewind cleanses you of every harmful effect.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_shards.lore: A moment left behind shatters into ice.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_shards.desc: Where your Rewind began bursts into frost: monsters within 3 blocks take 4 damage and Slowness II for 3 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_haste.lore: Back again, do not stand still.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_haste.desc: After a Rewind, Speed II for 4 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_return.lore: The way back can be walked forward too.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_return.desc: Within 3 seconds after a Rewind, press R again to fly back for free to where you left.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_ally.lore: You can bring back more than yourself.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_ally.desc: Sneak + R rewinds the player you look at (up to 16 blocks) along their own trail. 40 sand.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_eternal.lore: A moment can last forever if you never let it go.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_eternal.desc: Crown. When your health drops below a quarter, for 6 seconds you cannot be killed, and then your health returns to what it was at the start. Once in 10 minutes.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_wide.lore: Time stands still over a wider ground.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_wide.desc: The Dome has a radius of 7 blocks instead of 5.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_long.lore: The dome holds as long as you do.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_long.desc: The Dome lasts 9 seconds instead of 6.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_cheap.lore: A little sand and time obeys.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_cheap.desc: The Dome costs 35 sand instead of 45.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_deep.lore: Under the dome even rage slows down.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_deep.desc: Enemies under the Dome get Weakness II: their blows barely hurt.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_return.lore: What stood still can run backwards.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_return.desc: When the Dome ends, the arrows and projectiles hanging in it fly back at whoever shot them.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_mend.lore: In still time wounds are in no hurry.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_freeze.lore: One look and the moment does not move.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_freeze.desc: Left Alt: the enemy you look at (up to 16 blocks) freezes for 3 seconds. 25 sand, once in 20 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_shatter.desc: When the Dome ends, enemies inside take 6 damage.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_ward.lore: A blow sinks into the sand before it lands.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_ward.desc: Inside your own Dome you take 25% less damage.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_stop.lore: The world can be stopped. Briefly.
mages_legacy.talent.stasis_stop.desc: Crown. Once in 5 minutes the Dome also stops everything within 16 blocks: mobs and projectiles freeze completely for 3 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_area.lore: The sand flows to all the neighbours.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_area.desc: The Quickening takes the blocks around too (a 3 by 3 by 3 cube) and lasts 60 seconds instead of 30.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_haste.lore: Frozen hands run ahead of time.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_haste.desc: Permanent Haste I: you dig and swing faster.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_regen.lore: You have learnt to live in your own time.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_regen.desc: Natural healing is only a quarter slower instead of half.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_swift.lore: You are always a little ahead.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_sand.lore: The sand in you runs faster.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_sand.desc: Sand of time gathers twice as fast.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_current.lore: Time flows through you, and you through time.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_current.desc: Crown. Key H: for 30 seconds you do everything twice as fast (Speed II, Haste II, Strength), and your abilities recharge twice as fast. 30 sand, once in 5 minutes.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_strike.lore: You already know where to strike: you have been here.
mages_legacy.talent.loop_strike.desc: Your first blow within 4 seconds after a Rewind deals double damage.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_viscous.lore: For whoever you strike, time thickens.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_viscous.desc: Your blows give Slowness II for 2 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_echo.lore: The blow comes before it is expected, and once more.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_echo.desc: Every third blow of yours lands twice: 50% more damage.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_feed.lore: Every wound of the enemy spills sand.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_feed.desc: Every blow you land on a monster gives 2 sand of time.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_overtake.lore: You are no longer where the blow lands.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_overtake.desc: Blur triggers twice as often (20%), and after a dodge you get Speed II for 2 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_recharge.lore: Your hourglass runs faster than others.
mages_legacy.talent.flow_recharge.desc: The Rewind and the Dome recharge 25% faster.
mages_legacy.race.bloodkin.perk.4: Thirst: with little blood left, faster and 20% harder-hitting
mages_legacy.branch.bloodkin.0.lore: Close combat: the dash, the bite, bleeding.
mages_legacy.branch.bloodkin.1.lore: Blood: keep it, draw it, give it.
mages_legacy.branch.bloodkin.2.lore: Darkness, the senses and the bat swarm.
mages_legacy.xp.bloodkin.2: Kill a living creature in Thirst
mages_legacy.xp.bloodkin.3: Catch an enemy in the Harvest
mages_legacy.xp.bloodkin.4: Cut an enemy with the Blood Dash
mages_legacy.bloodkin.too_weak: Too little health for a sacrifice
mages_legacy.bloodkin.prince: Prince of the Night: death missed you, you scattered into a swarm
mages_legacy.talent.fang_leech.desc: Vampirism: 15% of the damage to the living heals instead of 10%.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_bleed.lore: A fang wound does not close by itself.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_bleed.desc: Your blows on the living make them bleed: 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_reach.lore: Blood pulls farther than legs carry.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_reach.desc: The Blood Dash covers 14 blocks instead of 10.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_bite.lore: Sooner or later the fangs find the throat.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_bite.desc: Every fourth blow of yours on a living creature is a bite: +4 damage and +4 health to you.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_execute.lore: The weak already belong to you.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_execute.desc: Blows on enemies below a quarter of their health deal 50% more damage.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_deep.lore: Such a wound remembers the fang a long time.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_deep.desc: Bleeding is stronger and longer: 2 damage a second for 6 seconds, and it slows.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_double.lore: One rush to catch up, another to finish.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_double.desc: After a dash you may dash once more for free within 3 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_frenzy.lore: The smell of blood drives you on.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_frenzy.desc: Killing a living creature gives Strength and Speed for 5 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_open.lore: Blood flows to where it is awaited.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_open.desc: The bleeding of your victims gives you blood.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_trail.desc: The Blood Dash heals 3 health for every enemy it cuts.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_feast.lore: Once in a while blood flows like a river.
mages_legacy.talent.fang_feast.desc: Crown. Key H: for 8 seconds every blow heals you by all the damage it deals. 30 blood, once in 5 minutes.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_slow.lore: You have learnt not to spill.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_slow.desc: Blood drains away half as fast.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_harvest.lore: The far ones pay the mage's debt too.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_harvest.desc: The Harvest reaches enemies within 12 blocks instead of 9.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_sacrifice.lor: A drop of your own for a river of others'.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_sacrifice.des: The Blood Sacrifice costs 2 health instead of 4.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_hunger.desc: In Thirst your damage is +35% instead of +20%.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_edge.lore: You are used to living on the brink.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_edge.desc: In Thirst natural healing keeps working.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_drain.desc: The Harvest heals 4 health for each enemy instead of 2.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_offering.desc: After a Blood Sacrifice your vampirism is doubled for 5 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_rage.lore: Thirst is stilled only by the hunt.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_rage.desc: A kill in Thirst gives 15 blood at once.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_mark.lore: Whoever the harvest touched is marked.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_mark.desc: Enemies caught by the Harvest take 25% more damage from you for 6 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_vessel.lore: You have become a vessel for blood.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_vessel.desc: The Blood Sacrifice gives 50 blood and recharges twice as fast.
mages_legacy.talent.thirst_storm.desc: Crown. The Harvest draws blood three times in a row, a second apart.
mages_legacy.talent.night_eyes.desc: At night and in the dark you have night vision.
mages_legacy.talent.night_sense.lore: You hear hearts from far away.
mages_legacy.talent.night_sense.desc: Blood sense hears hearts within 24 blocks instead of 12.
mages_legacy.talent.night_shade.desc: The sun burns you half as often.
mages_legacy.talent.night_bats.lore: You are not a body, you are a flock.
mages_legacy.talent.night_bats.desc: Left Alt: scatter into a swarm of bats for 3 seconds, flying where you look, untouchable. 30 blood, once in 30 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.night_hush.lore: At night you make no sound.
mages_legacy.talent.night_hush.desc: At night monsters farther than 8 blocks lose sight of you.
mages_legacy.talent.night_cloak.lore: The sun no longer burns, it only weighs.
mages_legacy.talent.night_cloak.desc: Without a helmet the sun no longer sets you on fire, it only weakens you.
mages_legacy.talent.night_swarm.desc: Every living thing you fly through as a swarm bleeds.
mages_legacy.talent.night_ambush.lore: A back is the best place to strike.
mages_legacy.talent.night_ambush.desc: A blow in an enemy's back deals 30% more damage.
mages_legacy.talent.night_blood.lore: At night blood sleeps in the veins.
mages_legacy.talent.night_blood.desc: At night your blood does not drain away, and you regenerate.
mages_legacy.talent.night_prince.lore: The night does not let its prince go.
mages_legacy.talent.night_prince.desc: Crown. At night +25% damage and Speed, and a killing blow at night scatters you into a swarm with 30% health instead of killing you (once in 20 minutes).
mages_legacy.race.voidborn.weak.3: The world's beds won't hold them: they sleep only in the Pocket
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.4.name: Pocket
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.4.desc: A rift opens before you, and a moment later you are in your Pocket. Pressed there, it takes you back to the very spot you left. Going in: 20 void, once in 10 seconds; coming out is free.
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.4.lore: A home always one step away.
mages_legacy.ability.no_resource.voidbor: Not enough void: it gathers in the dark and in the Pocket
mages_legacy.voidborn.no_sleep: This world's beds won't hold you: you can sleep only in your Pocket
mages_legacy.branch.voidborn.0.lore: Through walls: further, more often, with others.
mages_legacy.branch.voidborn.1.lore: The Well and the Excision: stronger and wider.
mages_legacy.branch.voidborn.2.lore: A world of your own: bigger, richer, nearer.
mages_legacy.xp.voidborn.1: Pass through a wall with the Void Step
mages_legacy.xp.voidborn.2: Pull an enemy into the Well
mages_legacy.talent.step_far.lore: The void is longer than it seems.
mages_legacy.talent.step_far.desc: The Void Step covers 18 blocks instead of 14.
mages_legacy.talent.step_cheap.lore: The more you walk it, the thinner the walls.
mages_legacy.talent.step_cheap.desc: The Void Step costs 14 void instead of 20.
mages_legacy.talent.step_quick.desc: The Void Step recharges in 3 seconds instead of 5.
mages_legacy.talent.step_cut.lore: Whoever stands in the way stands in the void.
mages_legacy.talent.step_cut.desc: Enemies in the Void Step's way take 7 damage instead of 4.
mages_legacy.talent.step_rend.lore: The void keeps a piece of everyone it touches.
mages_legacy.talent.step_rend.desc: Enemies the Void Step passes also get Weakness II for 4 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.step_twice.lore: One step is chance, two are a road.
mages_legacy.talent.step_twice.desc: For 3 seconds after a Void Step the next one costs nothing and needs no recharge.
mages_legacy.talent.step_veil.lore: You come out of the void, and it still clings.
mages_legacy.talent.step_veil.desc: 3 seconds of invisibility after a Void Step.
mages_legacy.talent.step_mend.lore: The void takes from them and gives to you.
mages_legacy.talent.step_mend.desc: Every enemy the Void Step cuts heals you 2 health.
mages_legacy.talent.step_rift.lore: You passed, and the door stayed open.
mages_legacy.talent.step_rift.desc: The rift where the step begins stays for 5 seconds: whoever walks into it comes out where you did.
mages_legacy.talent.step_ally.lore: The void is wide: there is room for two.
mages_legacy.talent.step_ally.desc: A player standing right beside you goes through with your Void Step.
mages_legacy.talent.step_sever.lore: The world is only cloth. And you are the knife.
mages_legacy.talent.step_sever.desc: Crown. The Void Step cuts all in its way: 12 damage and Slowness III.
mages_legacy.talent.well_wide.lore: The void's hunger knows no edge.
mages_legacy.talent.well_wide.desc: The Well draws in enemies within 11 blocks instead of 8.
mages_legacy.talent.well_long.lore: The void is in no hurry.
mages_legacy.talent.well_long.desc: The Well lasts 6 seconds instead of 4.
mages_legacy.talent.excise_long.lore: The longer there, the quieter they come back.
mages_legacy.talent.excise_long.desc: The Excision keeps a creature in your Pocket for 10 seconds instead of 6.
mages_legacy.talent.well_heart.lore: Nothing lives at the void's heart.
mages_legacy.talent.well_heart.desc: The Well's heart burns for 5 instead of 3.
mages_legacy.talent.well_collapse.lore: All that is gathered is one day crushed.
mages_legacy.talent.well_collapse.desc: The Well collapses for 10 damage instead of 6.
mages_legacy.talent.well_eat.lore: Arrows fly into the void and never come back.
mages_legacy.talent.well_eat.desc: Arrows and projectiles reaching the Well's heart are gone, and each gives 2 void.
mages_legacy.talent.excise_cheap.lore: The world gladly gives up what it doesn't need.
mages_legacy.talent.excise_cheap.desc: The Excision costs 25 void instead of 35.
mages_legacy.talent.well_hold.lore: Getting out of the well is harder than falling in.
mages_legacy.talent.well_hold.desc: When the Well collapses, every enemy in it gets Slowness II for 3 seconds.
mages_legacy.talent.well_hunger.lore: The void is grateful for its meal.
mages_legacy.talent.well_hunger.desc: An enemy killed while your Well pulled it gives back 10 void.
mages_legacy.talent.excise_drop.lore: The void gives back, but not where it took from.
mages_legacy.talent.excise_drop.desc: An excised enemy comes back 10 blocks above its spot, if there is sky there.
mages_legacy.talent.abyss_gaze.lore: Once the mage looked into the void. The void still looks out through his eyes.
mages_legacy.talent.abyss_gaze.desc: Crown. Left Alt: every enemy within 16 blocks falls into the void at once for 4 seconds and comes back dazed. 50 void, once in 5 minutes.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_cheap.desc: Going into the Pocket costs 10 void instead of 20.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_quick.lore: One's own door opens by itself.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_quick.desc: Going into the Pocket recharges in 4 seconds instead of 10.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_wide.desc: The Pocket's island is 15x15 instead of 9x9. Everything built on it stays.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_water.lore: Water is still a stranger, but no longer a foe.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_guests.lore: A home you can invite others into.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_guests.desc: Players within 3 blocks come into the Pocket with you, and come out when you do.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_ward.lore: You leave home, and it still holds you.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_ward.desc: 3 seconds of Resistance II after leaving the Pocket.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_garden.lore: No day there, no night, only growing.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_garden.desc: Plants on your Pocket island grow three times as fast.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_storm.lore: The world's sky is wet, but no longer as heavy.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_storm.desc: Rain brings only Weakness, no Slowness.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_home.lore: From the pocket you can see every door at once.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_home.desc: Leaving the Pocket with sneak held takes you to your bed or spawn point.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_hearth.lore: The mage didn't let them die then. He won't now.
mages_legacy.talent.pocket_hearth.desc: Crown. A killing blow takes you into your Pocket instead, with half your health and all your things; from there you come out at your spawn point. Once in 20 minutes.
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.5.name: The Mage's Gaze
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.5.desc: Crown of the Abyss. Every enemy within 16 blocks falls into the void at once for 4 seconds and comes back dazed. 50 void, once in 5 minutes.
mages_legacy.ability.voidborn.5.lore: Once the mage looked into the void. The void still looks out through his eyes.
mages_legacy.voidborn.hearth: The void wouldn't give you to death: you are in your Pocket. The way out leads to your spawn point.
